newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - NORTH HAVEN, CONN..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - NORTH HAVEN, CONN..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Town of North Haven, Connecticut, at North Haven Memorial Town Hall, Finance Office Conference Room, 18 Church Street, North Haven, Connecticut 06473, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Daylight Time) on

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of $19,275,000 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1997, payable on September 1 in each year as follows: $965,000 in each of the years 1998 through 2012 and $960,000 in each years 2013 through 2017. Bonds maturing after September 1, 2007 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the Town, on or after September 1, 2007. The Bonds will not be qualified tax-ex empt

obligations'', will be certified by State Street Bank and Trust Company of Connecticut, N.A., Hartford, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about September 4, 1997, subject to the approving opinion of Day, Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book- entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities depository. Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the Town's Official Statement may be obtained from Ms. Karen E. Hence, Assistant Vice President, at Fleet Securities, Inc., Municipal
Advisory Group, 17th Floor, 777 Main Street, Hartford, Connecticut 06115 (telephone: (860) 986-3647).
